steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: What is this place...?
Fossilized sandworm carcasses half-buried in white sand are strewn as far as the eye can see. A few meters away, you spot the ruins of an old wall.
You search all over the place, and a dilapidated palace catches your attention.
You pick up the lighting equipment and step inside...
Ruined palace, first floor of the main hall.
The main gates of the palace have already collapsed. Someone seems to have smashed a hole in the side wall.
There is no sunlight within these walls. A faint gloom permeates the air, and blinding darkness stretches as far as the eye can see.
No one has visited the main hall for a long time. Dust and sand blankets every corner of the room.

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: These are...?
A trail of footprints meanders across the sand-covered ground. Clearly, someone has been here before you.
As you follow the footprints, you catch a faint whiff of fragrance unique to the Ferotti.
...It's Stargazer!
You quicken your pace, only to trip over the bottles and jars scattered across the floor.

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: Are those... lab equipment?
Those are clearly things that should not appear here.
You hastily raise the lighting equipment to scout around. The place is divided into several different areas, and the floor is scattered with thick wires.
You check one area after another. To your surprise, you find a playback device that still works.
Tsss tsss tsss... after a long buzz of static noise, you hear the rustle of flipping pages.
"Day 3 of the Usum Experiment. Small desert worms used for small-scale experimentation. Number used: 5."

"Test subjects reacted vehemently and mutated when placed in close proximity to the target. Mutations include, but are not limited to, enlarged body size, thickened bones, and the growth of sharp fangs."
"Moreover, the test subject and the target clearly established communications, or rather, the specimen unilaterally controlled the subject."
"...Tsss tsss... Day 10 of the Usum Experiment. Sexually mature Homo sapiens used as test subjects for experimentation. Number used: 10."

"Two-thirds of the test subjects showcased signs of intense stress when placed in close proximity to the target. Reactions include, but are not limited to, shrieking, mental breakdowns, hallucinations, self-harm or attacks against each other."

...Moreover, after exhibiting such symptoms for 17 to 20 hours, the subjects each died and produced a strange lifeform with strong magnetic interference. Or rather... we're not sure if it can be called a 'lifeform'...
These recordings suggest that an unknown group was conducting some kind of test on their so-called target.

"Day 28 of the Usum Experiment. We have confirmed that the target has a high dimensional level of cognition and is capable of deconstructing, analyzing, and guiding the consciousness of all living organisms."
"This type of guidance is not simply consciousness manipulation. It is more like a powerful, immutable rule that is placed on the test subject."
Tsss.... according to... tsss... remaining one-third of test subjects... tsss... became dependent, awestruck and spiritually devoted towards the target.
"...The research team defined the target's description as... understanding and empathy."
"The core crystals in the target's body are the source of its power. However, our experimentation has so far failed to determine the source of the target."
The human voice in the playback device suddenly pauses, leaving only the hum of static.
"Could it really be... as the mural depicts..."
This last phrase seems to be a murmur of self-reflection on the part of the recorder. You pick up a key word... Mural.

You return to the ruins outside the palace, raising the light in your hand to scrutinize the carvings on the wall... Sure enough, the seemingly irregular shapes and symbols actually form a grand mural.
The mural depicts the sun, moon and stars falling from the sky. Upon reaching the mortal world, they transform into a flower that lands before a kneeling crowd of worshippers.
This doesn't seem to be a depiction of history, but more like humans' deification of an unknown lifeform.

"Day 44 of the Usum Experiment. The research team detected unidentified dark shadows while searching for test subjects. We speculate that frequent experimentation on the target has affected lifeforms in a higher dimension."
"Day 45 of the Usum Experiment... Tsss... A multitude of dark shadows is approaching the research site. To be safe, once... tsss... is in place, the ceremony shall commence immediately."
The sound in the device cuts off at this point.
An unknown group, experimentation, sandworms, core crystals, dark shadows, the ceremony...
You feel like you've peeked into a secret corner of this realm. Once you grasp the clues scattered across WhiteSands, the hidden truth shall emerge.
Boom!!!
You are suddenly plunged into darkness, and your ears begin to ring with countless voices.
Crashing, roaring, screaming... the cacophony is like a drum pounding in your ears, causing you unbearable pain.
You force yourself up, pushing through the sharp pain. Then, you find yourself in familiar dead silence.
"Day 45 of the Usum Experiment... Tsss... A multitude of dark shadows is approaching the research site. To be safe, once... tsss... is in place, the ceremony shall commence immediately."
Are the black shadows referring to... the Apostles of Ashes?
A chill runs down your spine. The rustling sounds around you give you goosebumps.

As your eyes adjust to the darkness, you discover that things are grimmer than you expected... Countless Corruptors, whose souls have been devoured by the Tide of Ashes, are waiting for you along the edges of the darkness.
